question: Does a deterministic residual-directed crossing flip define a Q-preserving sector transport with size-uniform inverse multiplicity and action distortion?
claim_boundary: This is an exact finite construction and analytic obstruction test. It cannot establish a thermodynamic phase or threshold; a transport is promoted only if every structural gate passes and a size-uniform bound is proved.

transport.residual_orientation: stored edge direction when j_e=0 and reversed direction when j_e=1
transport.domain: states whose residual digraph has a directed crossing between opposite rough sides
transport.path_rule: minimize path length, then prefer left-to-right over right-to-left, then lexicographically minimize edge-index sequence and vertex sequence
transport.action: toggle j_e on every selected path edge
transport.expected_invariants: binary feasibility, unchanged measured integer Q, and flipped logical parity

metrics: domain equality with ambiguous charge-fiber membership
maximum inverse multiplicity and multiplicity histogram
maximum reciprocal weight distortion at p=.30 and p=.50

analytic_controls.all_zero: The all-zero current selects a shortest all-forward crossing of length L-1, so Delta N=L-1.
analytic_controls.weight_ratio: w(Tj)/w(j)=(p/(1-p))^DeltaN; for p!=1/2 the all-zero witness already forbids a size-uniform two-sided distortion bound.

acceptance.structural: zero domain, binary, Q and logical-flip failures
acceptance.multiplicity: a proved L-independent inverse-multiplicity bound, not merely equal values at L3/L4
acceptance.action: a proved L-independent two-sided weight-ratio bound in the declared p region
acceptance.promotion: only if structural, multiplicity and action gates all pass
acceptance.rejection: any failed structural gate or analytic size-growing multiplicity/action obstruction rejects this rule as a uniform coupling

stop_rule: Stop after L3/L4 exhaustive evaluation and the all-zero analytic control. Do not tune the path order or add sizes after seeing the result.
outcome: All structural gates pass, but maximum inverse multiplicity grows from 3 to 8 and the all-zero witness proves exponential reciprocal weight distortion for every fixed p!=1/2. The registered rule is rejected as a size-uniform coupling; midpoint multiplicity remains a distinct open gate.
